scientific_integrity: All formulas have a self-contained combinatorial derivation and a reproducible finite independent enumerator; finite checking corroborates and does not prove the infinite theorem. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact distribution concerns uniform complete injective finite-base tuple types of the homogeneous binary-branching C-relation, equivalently non-plane binary rooted PDA leaf grafting with ordered new labelled leaves. It does not apply automatically to Yule-Harding growth or uniform random vertices, or other rooted relational classes. The general strong Rayleigh implication is published theory; no historical uniqueness, external audit, or independent certification is asserted.
title: A strongly Rayleigh retention law for marked cherries in homogeneous rooted tree types
